mainEntity.name: Why does consular coordination matter in a consular matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: The key point is that the competent authority matters because the same objective can involve different procedures, booking systems, and expectations depending on where the step occurs. In real cases, consular coordination changes route fit, documents, and timing. No public explanation can replace a review of the actual file.
